name: toys_multimodal_followup_20261028
scope_confirmed_by_user: Product recommendation using interaction history, product image, and product title/description. Cold-start item performance is a subgroup analysis; no-history is a fallback, not proven new-user personalization.
selection: Select best checkpoint by arithmetic mean NDCG@10 over zero_shot, extreme_cold, and cold on historical validation v1, with the same early-stopping rule for all variants. Never select by v3 or seen test v2.
reporting: Report every training seed, mean and sample standard deviation for cold macro NDCG@10 and each regime; include overall, history/no-history, repeat/new purchase and predictions. Validation v3 is exploratory on a population already used for checkpoint selection, not a fresh holdout.
source_layout: Paths above are relative to a complete restored FITLAB workspace. The three src files must be updated together from this repository before any new run; archived checkpoints are only for historical evaluation with their archived source.
test_policy: Do not use test v2 for checkpoint/model/seed choice. A new independent test requires a separately justified source and protocol before opening labels.
